== calls

ls --json
exec cpb-revoke bash -lc cat ~/.cpb-sandbox 2>/dev/null
secret ls --sandbox cpb-revoke

exec -i -e ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=http://router.local:9/v1 -e CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=<ROOT>/revoke cpb-revoke bash -lc cd '<WORK>' && exec claude
